rationale: NBS supervised-entity/PSD2 registers are an authoritative, daily-updated register of the SK banking and payments actor universe.
Third-party scraper tool for FinStat; legally unclear and not a signal source - licensed FinStat API is the compliant path.
Slovak Banking Association portal enumerates ~24 member banks and publishes ongoing sector positions and statistics.
High-value standards/projects section but a sub-page of sbaonline.sk already monitored as parent.
SBA press releases and statistics are a section of the monitored SBA parent domain.
Association training arm; only weak indirect vendor signal via course catalogues.
ITAS member directory is the best single enumeration of SK IT vendors and integrators selling into banks; mine and diff periodically.
ITAS news and position papers are a continuously producing hub on SK ICT agenda and member positioning.
SAPIE ~200-member roster captures fintech and digital challengers missing from ITAS.
Single transparency-register datacard; useful as a one-off cross-check on association membership and lobbying spend.
AmCham member directory is a useful vendor cohort but url verification failed and directories are often member-gated.
Britcham ~120-member list complements AmCham for UK-linked financial services vendors.
AHK Slovakia publishes no full public roster; value depends on access to the member list.
SBCB corporate pages enumerate ~17 member lending institutions and name the CRIF vendor dependency; register content itself is off-limits.
NBCB member list maps the ~32-strong non-bank lending and leasing buyer segment.
ALS SR gives both a leasing-company roster and recurring quarterly volume statistics, so it keeps producing signal.
SLASPO enumerates insurers plus associated service-provider tiers and publishes ongoing sector news; bancassurance links to banks.
SKP gives an authoritative census of MTPL insurers and occasional shared-IT procurement signals.
SASS associated-member tier surfaces custodians, distributors and IT/data vendors in collective investment.
FINAS covers the fintech/insurtech cohort no other association captures and publishes ongoing member and event news.
Rival fintech association with a thin public roster; reconstruct members from the state register or FinStat instead.
Named member list for the SK crypto/tokenised-payments cohort, relevant under MiCA but peripheral to bank vendors.
Commitments registry names concrete digital projects and partner pairs across bank and IT members, and is continuously updated.
Authoritative MV SR register of interest associations; the fallback for founders and officers where associations publish no roster.
FinStat entity records and udalosti feeds are valuable for entity resolution but are commercial and should be licensed, not scraped.
Single vendor membership page; the reverse-citation technique matters more than this one URL.
ITAPA partner and exhibitor rosters plus archived editions give a dated multi-year read on integrators selling into SK digitalisation.
Cena ITAPA shortlists name vendor-client delivery pairs but sit on the itapa.sk parent already monitored; url check failed, recheck liveness.
